stories.title: Apprehension in Denmark ahead of talks about Greenland with Vance
stories.summary: Leaders from Denmark and Greenland will meet with top U.S. officials in Washington on Wednesday to try to find a way out of a crisis caused by President Trump repeated demands to annex Greenland.

stories.title: Trump calls on Iranians to keep protesting but the death toll is rising
stories.summary: President Trump calls on Iranians to keep protesting, but the regime is cracking down hard and the death toll is rising.

stories.title: Minnesota federal prosecutors resign after DOJ push to investigate Renee Good's widow
stories.summary: Federal prosecutors in Minnesota have resigned after the DOJ pushed for an investigation into the widow of Renee Good, after Good was fatally shot last week by an ICE agent.

stories.title: Markets and restaurants return to Gaza, but few can afford the expensive price tag
stories.summary: New eateries are popping up in Gaza after months of famine, but it's pricey and many people still rely on aid to survive.

stories.title: The 2026 Tiny Desk Contest begins
stories.summary: NPR Music's search for the next great undiscovered artist to play a Tiny Desk concert kicks off today. Host and series producer Bobby Carter shares what the judges are looking for in entries.

stories.title: Will these tech trends take off in 2026?
stories.summary: Every year, the MIT Technology Review publishes a list of 10 breakthroughs poised to take off in the coming year. Amy Nordrum, executive editor of operations there, talks through this year's entries.
